package verificationfixture

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func TestLoadDefinitionHasOneVersionedGuestCourseFixture(t *testing.T) {
	definition, err := LoadDefinition()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if definition.FixtureID != "course_catalog_smoke" || definition.FixtureVersion != 1 || definition.Slug != "verification-course-v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected fixture identity: %+v", definition)
	}
	for role, id := range map[string]string{
		"course":  definition.IDs.Course,
		"module":  definition.IDs.Module,
		"section": definition.IDs.Section,
		"lesson":  definition.IDs.Lesson,
		"task":    definition.IDs.Task,
	} {
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(id); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("%s id is not a UUID: %v", role, err)
		}
	}
	var structure map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(definition.Task.CodeStructure, &structure); err != nil || structure["type"] != "quiz_theory" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected task code structure: %s (error %v)", definition.Task.CodeStructure, err)
	}
	if definition.Task.RequiresSandbox || definition.Task.ExecutionMode != "NO_RUN" {
		t.Fatal("fixture prerequisite task must not require a sandbox")
	}
}
